title: Implement structured machine-wide recording
objective: Provide operator-readable structured records, safe retention, and pre-start lookup instructions.
output_format: Structured record sink, retention/ACL tests, fidelity backstop, invariant contract test, and operator documentation.
tool_guidance: Record allowlisted fields only; do not persist raw stdout, stderr, environment, or secrets.
task_boundaries: Own structured records, retention, ACL integration, and lookup documentation; exclude lifecycle decisions and stop authority.
acceptance: ProgramData path, ACL, 10 MiB x5, and 30-day policy are enforced.
SCM pre-process failures have a deterministic documented lookup.
decision_closure_reason: The log path, retention, ACL, allowlist, and SCM complement are fixed by the machine-wide record ADR.
